title: CLCON/175/2005 of HARISH CHANDRA LAL SAH Vs TRIBHUWAN RAM  and ORS

paras.text:
Misc.Appln. 6149/2005
In
CLCON No.175 of 2005
Hon. P.C. Pant, J.
 With this miscellaneous
application, an affidavit has been filed
by respondent No. 1, wherein it has
been stated that compliance of the
order dated 10.03.2005, passed by this
Court in Special Appeal No. 104 of
2004 has been complied with. In the
affidavit, annexures annexed thereto,
show that the payment of Rs.
1,62,088/- has been made through
government treasury cheque No.
779490 dated 10th August, 2005 and
payment of cost of Rs. 10,000/- has
been made vide Demand Draft No.
072273 dated 16th August, 2005.
 In view of this compliance
report, there appears no wilful
disobedience on the part of the
respondent. Accordingly, the
application is allowed and the
contempt petition No. 175 of 2005 is
dismissed and notices issued to the
respondents are discharged.
(P.C. Pant, J.)
Dt. 25.08.2005
 HN
